classes.name: Autoloader
classes.description: Manages class autoloading by registering namespaces and directories, supporting PSR-4 standards as well as legacy structures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the autoloader, registers the default PHP extension for autoloading.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a namespace with its directory, and whether to follow PSR-4 standards.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Attempts to load a class file based on the registered namespace paths and class name.
